description: Fetch a Swiss National Bank cube's dimensions/structure (the dimension items / series keys available within the cube). Use this to understand what a cube contains before/after calling get_cube. Verified-live cube IDs: devkua = foreign exchange rates (CHF per currency); zimoma = money market & reference rates incl. SARON; rendoblid = Confederation/euro bond spot interest rates (yield curve); snbmonagg = monetary aggregates (M1/M2/M3, currency in circulation). Defaults to devkua (FX rates).
name: cube_structure
